boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named University of Dallas study environments, selected from a current university-published guide and described only with its documented features.

cards.title: Frassati's
cards.subtitle: Haggar food court area
cards.notes: Set up in a booth, at a high table, or in a window nook when you want a furnished indoor place to read or work.
cards.short_summary: Booths, high tables, and window nooks provide several seating formats.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Dallas describes Frassati's as having comfortable booths, high tables, and window nooks for studying.
cards.access_notes: Located beside the Cap Bar and rotating quick-serve food options; the cited guide does not state reservation or public-access rules.

cards.title: Cowan-Blakley Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: Braniff and Blakley Buildings
cards.notes: Choose among the basement, second, or third floors for tables and desks with varying privacy, including some window views.
cards.short_summary: A multi-floor library setting with tables, desks, and varied privacy.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Dallas says the library's basement, second, and third floors have tables and desks with varying levels of privacy.
cards.access_notes: The library FAQ states public hours are 8 a.m.–5 p.m. Monday–Friday and student hours vary with the academic calendar; check current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Cowan-Blakley Periodicals Room
cards.subtitle: Cowan-Blakley Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use the library's designated quiet zone when you need a setting explicitly identified for sustained, low-distraction work.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet-zone option inside Cowan-Blakley Memorial Library.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Dallas identifies the Cowan-Blakley Memorial Library periodicals room as an official quiet zone.
cards.access_notes: Located within Cowan-Blakley Memorial Library; consult current library hours, which vary by academic calendar.

cards.entity_name: Satish & Yasmin Gupta College of Business Third Floor
cards.title: Gupta College of Business Third Floor
cards.subtitle: Satish & Yasmin Gupta College of Business
cards.notes: Take a booth or table on the third floor for an indoor workspace specifically described by the university as a quiet place to focus.
cards.short_summary: Third-floor booths and tables in the College of Business.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Dallas says the third floor has booths and tables and is generally a quiet place for focused work.
cards.access_notes: Indoor academic-building space; the cited guide does not state reservation, after-hours, or public-access rules.

cards.entity_name: Braniff Graduate School of Liberal Arts Third Floor
cards.title: Braniff Third Floor
cards.subtitle: Braniff Graduate School of Liberal Arts
cards.notes: Use the circular desks and nearby round tables when your work benefits from face-to-face discussion under the third-floor sunroof.
cards.short_summary: A sunlit third-floor setup with circular desks and tables.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Dallas describes Braniff's third floor as having a sunroof, circular-facing desks, and additional circular tables.
cards.access_notes: The university guide places this space next to the library's third floor; it does not state reservation or after-hours access rules.

cards.title: Haggerty Science Center Window Nooks
cards.subtitle: Haggerty Science Center
cards.notes: Use a window nook for seated work with an indoor view across the Mall; bring only what you need for a compact nook setup.
cards.short_summary: Indoor nooks with seating and views of the Mall.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Dallas describes the Haggerty Science Center window nooks as comfortable and providing a view of the Mall from indoors.
cards.access_notes: Indoor academic-building space; the cited guide does not state reservation, after-hours, or public-access rules.

cards.title: Outside the Cap Bar
cards.subtitle: Outdoor study area by the Cap Bar
cards.notes: Bring weather-ready materials and use the vine-shaded seating area outside the Cap Bar for outdoor reading or laptop work.
cards.short_summary: A shaded outdoor area formed by winding vines near the Cap Bar.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Dallas describes an outdoor study area outside the Cap Bar shaded by winding vines.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus location; weather and normal campus access conditions apply. The cited guide gives no reservation information.

cards.title: Constantin Memorial Garden
cards.subtitle: Patio garden outside the Gorman Faculty Lounge
cards.notes: Use the patio garden for outdoor reading or a short work session, locating yourself outside the Gorman Faculty Lounge in the Mall's center.
cards.short_summary: A named patio garden in the center of the Mall.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Dallas locates the Constantin Memorial Garden outside the Gorman Faculty Lounge in the center of the Mall.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus location; weather and normal campus access conditions apply. The cited guide gives no reservation information.

cards.entity_name: Outside Braniff Graduate School of Liberal Arts
cards.title: Outside Braniff
cards.subtitle: Exterior of Braniff Graduate School of Liberal Arts
cards.notes: Use the built-in wall benches or exterior tables for reading outdoors, choosing the Mall-facing or SB Hall-facing side to suit your view.
cards.short_summary: Built-in benches and exterior tables around Braniff.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Dallas states that benches are built into Braniff's exterior walls and that outdoor tables surround the building.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus location; weather and normal campus access conditions apply. The cited guide gives no reservation information.

cards.entity_name: Church of the Incarnation Lawn and Amphitheater
cards.title: Church of the Incarnation Lawn and Amphitheater
cards.subtitle: Church of the Incarnation
cards.notes: Bring a book or meet a small study group on the lawn's stone benches, using the outdoor setting during suitable weather.
cards.short_summary: A 2025-completed lawn and amphitheater with stone benches.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Dallas says the Church of the Incarnation Lawn and Amphitheater was completed in August 2025 and includes stone benches for study groups.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus location; weather and normal campus access conditions apply. The cited guide gives no reservation information.
